voiceoverSegments.line: We start by loading the last 1000 candles, giving the strategy its price history to work with.
Next we add a 20-period EMA, which smooths the price while favoring newer moves.
Then we layer a 40-period EMA beneath it, creating a slower trend line for comparison.
We plot the first EMA in blue so its trend stands out on the chart.
We compare the two EMAs with a greater-than test, flagging when the faster line sits above the slower.
We plot the second EMA in orange, making the crossover relationship easy to see.
We then run the strategy through the backtest engine, generating trades based on those EMA signals.
Finally we overlay the trades on the chart, showing entry and exit points for visual review.

outro.voiceover: You now see both EMAs plotted, with highlighted crossovers and trade markers, ready to backtest.
